★ Work at Doherty's

Join the team

We're often on the lookout for new staff, so applications are welcome any time — even when no position is advertised. Two paths in:

Casual Gym Attendant

The crew on the floor and behind the desk. Casual employees on a weekly roster across varying shifts — full training provided.

  • Customer service, assisting with & selling memberships, answering phones
  • Cafe duty — preparing and serving coffee and shakes
  • Selling meals, supplements and merchandise
  • General cleaning duties — night shifts lean heavier on cleaning, lighter on service
  • Full training provided for successful applicants

Personal Trainer

Not an employee position — it's the opportunity to run your own PT business at the world-famous Doherty's Gym.

  • Leads from new memberships
  • Digital advertising in the gym, plus a profile on this website
  • An intro video filmed for social media
  • Affordable weekly rates, and a free gym membership
  • No lock-in contracts after 3 months

★ The Legacy

Founded by Tony Doherty

Doherty's was founded by Tony Doherty — Arnold Schwarzenegger's business partner and President of the IFBB Pro League Australia. The gyms carry that old-school lineage in every corner: contest posters, a dedicated posing room, and a floor culture built on showing up.

It's also a home away from home. The gym is more than a place to get fit — it's a place to belong, welcoming people from all walks of life.

"More than a place to get fit — a place to belong."
